note: Generated by scripts/build-arsenal.mjs. Do not edit by hand. The game is frozen at 9.7.0.4; this file only changes if the bake rules do.

meta.iconNote: Weapon icon values are relative to iconPrefix; a value starting with "/" kept its full manifest path.
meta.rolls: columns lists trait and origin perk pools per socket index for legendaries, hashes only; resolve display names through perkNames. Barrel and magazine columns are deliberately not baked: they do not decide whether an instance has a wanted damage roll, and dropping them keeps this file lazy-loadable.
meta.sunset: Power caps in the final manifest: 1010, 999940, 999950, 999960, 999970, 999980, 999990. Every legendary/exotic weapon version references an uncapped sentinel (>= 900000), so the sunset filter excluded 0 weapons. Sunsetting is dead in the frozen game; the filter stays as a guard.
meta.skippedPerks: Repulsor Brace (defensive, not a damage perk) and Master of Arms (no public post-9.7.0 source) are deliberately absent from damagePerks.
meta.legendariesWithoutTraitColumns: 0 baked legendary definitions lack a trait pool. The "Randomized Perks" placeholder display copies in the manifest are itemType 0, not weapons, so they never enter the bake; the guard against the placeholder plug stays anyway.
